proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D _ hs hpar
  rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev] at hpar
  have m1 : C -ᵥ D ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {B -ᵥ A} := by rw [hpar]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp m1
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by
    by_contra hk0
    rcases (not_lt.mp hk0).lt_or_eq with hneg | hz
    · have hD : D = (-k) • (B -ᵥ A) +ᵥ C := by
        rw [neg_smul, hk, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, vsub_vadd]
      have h3 := AffineSubspace.sSameSide_smul_vsub_vadd_left (s := line[ℝ, A, C]) hs.2.1
        (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C) (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C) (neg_pos.mpr hneg)
      rw [← hD] at h3
      exact h3.symm.not_sOppSide hs
    · rw [hz, zero_smul] at hk
      exact hs.2.2 (vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq.mp hk.symm ▸ right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C)
  unfold EuclideanGeometry.angle
  rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C D, ← hk, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C A, InnerProductGeometry.angle_neg_neg,
    InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_left_of_pos _ _ hkpos]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), A ≠ C → (line[ℝ, A, C]).SOppSide B D → (line[ℝ, A, B]).Parallel line[ℝ, D, C] → EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = EuclideanGeometry.angle D C A
